messages.text: Several important on-page SEO problems emerged from my review of your website. On the homepage, both the meta title and description are too long; it also contains multiple H1 tags and an improper heading structure, while many images lack ALT attributes. Addressing these findings should improve the website's SEO performance, crawlability, and search visibility.

messages.text: The current figures—around 145 monthly visits and an Authority Score of 27—show that the website receives very low organic traffic and has low authority, leaving significant room for improvement. I'm following up on the website audit report I previously shared. For every day the website remains less than fully optimized, another opportunity to attract potential customers through Google is missed.

By applying the right on-page SEO improvements and link-building strategy, I can increase your organic traffic and strengthen your online presence. If you're interested, I can also send a customized SEO strategy covering the priority fixes, the implementation process, and the expected results.

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text:
Several growth opportunities for your business stand out. Search-engine visibility is currently being restricted by the website's limited keyword rankings, weak backlink profile, and low organic traffic.

The brand also has little to no presence on emerging AI search and answer platforms, including ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity, where millions of users now discover and evaluate businesses. Improving both SEO and AI visibility can significantly expand your online reach, generate more qualified leads, and build long-term brand authority.
